title: dispatch-gates: a change to spec migration entries does not derive the cli migrate-meta-engine guidance test that reads them
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: a gate-derivation blind spot found on PR #34654 (card #34451's area). Dedupe: `migrate-meta-engine-guidance dispatch-gates`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:skills (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`) · tooling

## What happened

PR #34654 edited text under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**`. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derived 98 gate families for that file surface and none of them was `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`, which reads the migration entries through the published `@objectstack/spec` and refuses an entry whose printed guidance carries a card number. The case went red only in CI (head `f11fa429`), after the local `dispatch-gates --ran` ledger was fully green.

## What is wanted

Teach `dispatch-gates` that a change under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` owes `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (or derive it generally from the cli tests that consume spec migration entries), with a self-test row. Strengthens an existing gate's derivation; adds no new gate.

## Re-check

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/index.ts | grep -c migrate-meta-engine-guidance` (0 today)
